tax.text: She has made cutting taxes for working and middle-class families a stated priority and led a tax-cut effort in the Michigan Senate.
tax.quote: Her top priorities include cutting taxes for the working and middle class, lowering the cost of groceries, housing, prescription drugs, and childcare, and bringing good-paying jobs to mid-Michigan.

wages.text: She promoted an affordability agenda that calls for increasing the minimum wage and protecting workers’ rights.
wages.quote: To lower the cost of groceries and household essentials: roll back tariffs, reverse harmful cuts to federal nutrition programs, provide flexibility in federal lending and subsidy programs for small- and mid-size farmers, increase the minimum wage, and protect workers’ rights.

trade.text: She called for rolling back tariffs, saying they raise costs for families and threaten Michigan industries.
trade.quote: tariffs are making everything more expensive

debt.text: She said Social Security and Medicare are hard-earned benefits that should be protected.
debt.quote: She believes we must protect hard-earned benefits, like Social Security and Medicare.

schools.text: She supports expanding school funding for social workers, nurses, and counselors in school buildings.
schools.quote: I support expanded funding for schools to increase the number of social workers, nurses and counselors in our school buildings.

safety.text: She increased funding for local police as a city commissioner and has backed federal funding for law enforcement.
safety.quote: As a Bay City Commissioner, she increased funding to hire additional officers, and in the state Senate, she brought back to local departments millions to fund more officers, tools, and training.

guns.text: As a state senator, she introduced Michigan's safe gun-storage legislation.
guns.quote: When I introduced this legislation, it was my hope that it would never be used,

abortion.text: She helped repeal Michigan’s abortion ban and enshrine abortion rights in the state constitution.
abortion.quote: After the Dobbs decision, Kristen helped repeal Michigan’s extreme abortion ban and enshrine the right to abortion into Michigan’s constitution.

gender.text: She voted against the 2025 House bill that would define sex for federally supported athletics solely by reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

health.text: Her campaign says she is fighting to allow every American to buy into Medicare.
health.quote: she is fighting to let every American have the choice to buy into Medicare.

voting.text: She publicly committed to expanding voting rights.
voting.quote: I am proudly committed to working with Defend The Vote and doing everything in my power to preserve and strengthen our democracy, stand up to special interests, and expand voting rights.

housing.text: Her platform combines neighborhood preservation with affordable housing and removal of unnecessary barriers to development.
housing.quote: Affordable housing • Homelessness prevention • Neighborhood preservation • Homeownership • Removal of unnecessary barriers

schools.text: Her platform supports multiple school options and says funding should follow the student.
schools.quote: Parental involvement • School choice • Public, charter, private & homeschool options • Funding follows the student • Public-fund accountability

safety.text: Her platform supports law enforcement resources as well as youth programs and employment preparation.
safety.quote: Professional, trained & fairly compensated officers • Recruitment & retention • Equipment • Emergency response & ambulances • Civilian oversight • Body cameras • Constitutional accountability • Youth programs, coding, trades, financial literacy & employment preparation

immigration.text: Her platform calls for border enforcement alongside orderly legal immigration and due process.
immigration.quote: Secure borders • Credible enforcement • Orderly legal immigration • Barbara Jordan/U.S. Commission on Immigration Reform framework • Employer accountability • Serious-crime enforcement • Due process • Human dignity • National security

abortion.text: Her platform supports reproductive healthcare decisions, patient autonomy, and medical privacy while distinguishing personal faith from governmental authority.
abortion.quote: Patient autonomy • Reproductive healthcare decisions • Medical privacy • HIPAA protections • Stronger safeguards for government access to medical records

health.text: She supports universal healthcare coverage and public financing while seeking lower costs and broader access.
health.quote: Universal access • Public financing with private/nonprofit providers • Preventive/community care • Capitation & continuity of care • Prescription affordability • Generic competition

tax.text: He called for higher taxes on wealthy people and large businesses to fund infrastructure improvements.
tax.quote: Increase taxes on the wealthy and big business and use the money for infrastructure improvements.

wages.text: He called for raising the federal minimum wage to a living wage indexed to living costs.
wages.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage to a ‘living wage’, with cost of living adjustments, so more people can buy Chryslers, Fords and GM’s not Ferraris.

immigration.text: He called both for a secure border and for sympathy and openness toward people seeking to live in the United States, and said he supported the DREAM Act.
immigration.quote: We need a secure border and be sympathetic and open to the needs of those who want to live in the United States.

health.text: He endorsed a single-payer universal health-care system modeled on Canada’s.
health.quote: We need a Single-payer, Universal Health Care System, much like Canada.

wages.text: She said wages, pensions, and disability payments should rise automatically when prices increase.
wages.quote: I think wages, pensions and disability payments need to automatically and immediately increase whenever prices increase.

immigration.text: She said immigrants and noncitizens should have due-process and Fourth Amendment rights.
immigration.quote: It is wrong that immigrants and non-citizens are denied these rights.

guns.text: She said she would support curbing semiautomatic weapons and limiting magazines.
guns.quote: to curtail those semiautomatic weapons and to have those limits on magazines. I would be happy to see those things

abortion.text: She said abortion should be legal in all circumstances.
abortion.quote: So I believe abortion must be legal in all circumstances.

health.text: She described healthcare for all as part of a society that provides for working people.
health.quote: In a decent society that provided for the working class, there would be healthcare for all, affordable housing and wonderful schools.

energy.text: She supports a transition to renewable and cleaner energy financed by those who profited from fossil fuels.
energy.quote: there would be some kind of renewable energy, but that should be paid for out of the profits that have been amassed for generations from the old fossil fuels industry.

voting.text: She said voting should be easier, with absentee voting and fewer restrictions.
voting.quote: So opening up voting, opening up absentee voting, having less restrictions, having people have the day off from work so that they don't have to try to finish a 15 hour day like my coworkers do, and then try to figure out when to vote would be important.
